Daily Quiz.question:
১) Carefully read the question no- 01 to 09; These are the basic protective measures against the new coronavirus (Source: who.int).
Follow advice given by your healthcare provider, your national and local public health authority or your employer on how to protect yourself and others from COVID-19. Here, the underlined word is a/an-
Daily Quiz.exp: এটি একটি ভাইরাসের নাম। তাই এটি noun.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) The best way to protect yourself <u>against</u> COVID-19 is by frequently cleaning your hands. Here, against is a/an-
Daily Quiz.exp: COVID-19 একটি noun. এর পূর্বে against শব্দটি বসেছে। তাই এটি preposition.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Regularly and thoroughly clean your hands with an <u>alcohol-based</u> hand rub or wash them with soap and water. The underlined word is-
Daily Quiz.exp: article + adjective + noun.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Maintain at least 1 metre (3 feet) distance between yourself and anyone <u>who</u> is coughing or sneezing. The underlined word is a/an-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Here, 'who' is a relative pronoun.
Relative pronouns are also called ‘linking pronouns’ as they link the dependent relative clause of a sentence to its main clause.
Such as, I know the boy.
The boy came from Dhaka.
I know the boy who came from Dhaka.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Once <u>contaminated</u>, hands can transfer the virus to your eyes, nose or mouth. So, Avoid touching eyes, nose and mouth. Here, ‘contaminated is a/an-
Daily Quiz.exp: শব্দটি hands কে modify করায়, এটি adjective. এর verb form ‘contaminate’.

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Make sure you, and the people around you, follow good <u>respiratory</u> hygiene. This means covering your mouth and nose with your bent elbow or tissue when you cough or sneeze. The noun form of the underlined word is-
Daily Quiz.exp: Respiratory (noun): the act or process of breathing.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) “If you have a fever, cough and difficulty breathing, seek medical attention and call in advance”. In this sentence, which is the determiner?
Daily Quiz.exp: Article (a, an, the) সবসময়ই determiner এর অন্তর্ভূক্ত।

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Taking a hot bath will not <u>prevent</u> you from catching COVID-19. The adjective form of the underlined word is a/an-
Daily Quiz.exp:
preventable, preventible- adjective
prevention, preventability- noun
preventingly-adverb
nonpreventable- adjective

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Older <u>people</u>, and people with pre-existing medical conditions (such as asthma, diabetes, heart disease) appear to be more vulnerable to becoming severely ill with the virus. Here, people is a/an-
Daily Quiz.exp:
People- Countable Noun
Population- Uncountable Noun

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) The football match was telecast <u>live</u>. The underlined word is-
Daily Quiz.exp: এখানে live (সরাসরি) শব্দটি verb 'telecast' কে modify করায় এটি adverb.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) What part of speech is the underlined word in the sentence:The boys went <u> inside</u> to eat dinner.
Daily Quiz.exp: শব্দটি verb ‘went’ কে modify করায় এটি adverb.

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Which one of the following is both a noun and a verb?
Daily Quiz.exp:
সঠিক উত্তরঃ Brush এবং Practice উভয়ই।
Brush (verb): পরিস্কার/মসৃণ করা।
Brush (noun): ব্রাশ/ঝাড়/মার্জনী।
Practice (verb): অনুশীলন করা।
Practice (noun): অনুশীলন।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) 'It is <u>best</u> analysed in Samuelson'.Which part of speech is the underlined word?
Daily Quiz.exp: এই বাক্যে ‘best’ adverb হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়ে বাক্যের verb কে modify করেছে। তাই এটি adverb. এখানে Best মানে in the most suitable or appropriate way.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) I find it very<u> unlikely</u>.Which part of speech is the underlined word?
Daily Quiz.exp: Unlikely (adjective)- অঘটনীয়/অসম্ভাবনীয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) A preposition used with a verb is an _______.
Daily Quiz.exp: Verb এর পর শুধু মাত্র preposition আসলে তা adverb হয়। যেমন- He went down (adv).

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) Which is the example of a verbal noun among the underlined  words?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) <u>Writing</u> a good letter is difficult.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The<u> writing</u> of a good letter is difficult.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) It is very difficult to <u>write</u> a good letter.
Daily Quiz.exp: Verbal noun এর formation হচ্ছে- The + gerund (verb+ing) + of.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) What time did he get home last night? Here 'home' is a /an -
Daily Quiz.exp: এখানে Home হচ্ছে adverb of place.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) What is the abstract noun form of 'hero'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Heroism- বীরত্ব।
Abstract noun এর কোন physical existence থাকে না এবং এটি কোন অবস্তুগত ধারণা বা গুণকে নির্দেশ করে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Agenda is plural form of agendum. From which language the word 'agendum' has come in English?
Daily Quiz.exp: No explanation added.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Which one is the plural form of the word 'madam'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Madam শব্দের বহুবচন Mesdames.

Daily Quiz.question: ২১) Which is not a countable noun?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Crops, Tool, Fact, View- countable noun
Corn, Equipment, Information & Scenery- Uncountable noun.

Daily Quiz.question: ২২) Which one is masculine gender?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Masculine gender- Time, Death, Thunder
Feminine gender- Liberty, Autumn, Peace.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৩) _______ mother rose in her.
Daily Quiz.exp:
কিছু কিছু Noun আছে যাদের পূর্বে ‘The’ ব্যবহৃত হলে abstract noun এর অর্থ প্রকাশ করে।
যেমন- The mother rose in her অর্থাৎ তার মধ্যে মাতৃত্ব জেগে উঠল।
Control the beast in you- তোমার মধ্যে পশুত্বকে দমন কর।

Daily Quiz.question: ২৪) We should use _________ time we have at our study to pass the BCS preliminary examination.
Daily Quiz.exp: এখানে Time শব্দটা Uncountable noun, তাই এর পূর্বে Determiner হিসেবে  little (নেই বললেই চলে) বা the little (সামান্য যেটুকু আছে তার সবটুকু) বসবে। কিন্তু অর্থ বিবেচনায় the little ব্যবহার অধিক যুক্তিযুক্ত।

Daily Quiz.question: ২৫) Which is not an uncountable noun?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Advice, Baggage & Vocabulary- uncountable noun
Tip/suggestion, Bag, People & Word- countable noun.
Population can be used as a countable or uncountable noun. So, here Tip is the exact answer.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৬) I found the <u>worse</u> condition. The underlined word is -
Daily Quiz.exp: Bad শব্দটির Comparative এবং Superlative হচ্ছে যথাক্রমে worse এবং worst.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৭) Honesty is the best policy. Here the word 'honesty' is a /an-
Daily Quiz.exp: Abstract Noun হচ্ছে - যে Noun কোন অবস্তুগত ধারণা বা গুণকে নির্দেশ করে, যার কোন বাহ্যিক অস্তিত্ব নেই এবং যা ছোঁয়া যায় না, গন্ধ দ্বারা বা শ্রবণ দ্বারা বোঝা যায় না, কিন্তু কল্পনা দ্বারা বোঝা যায়। যেমন - Honesty, Boyhood, Justice, Slavery ইত্যাদি।

Daily Quiz.question: ২৮) I have no idea <u>who</u>(A) is the <u>most</u>(B) <u>smartest</u>(C), but I think it is the <u>bookish</u>(D) girl. Which underlined part is wrong?
Daily Quiz.exp: Smartest শব্দটি superlative degree. এর পাশে most শব্দটির ব্যবহার ভুল।

Daily Quiz.question: ২৯) Not until every single reporter had gone outside ________ his front door again.
Daily Quiz.exp: Not until যুক্ত sentence এর clause এ auxiliary verb + subject + base form of verb বসে। এটাকে inversion বলে এবং এর দ্বারা বাক্যে জোর প্রদান করা হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ৩০) He came to the office ________ his illness?
Daily Quiz.exp: Notwithstanding: in spite of.
